# Glass effect generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/glassmorphism/

Preview a frosted-glass card and copy its CSS. Adjust background blur, transparency, rounded corners and backdrop colors.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Generate a translucent card style to place over a colorful hero background.

## Limits and checks

Backdrop blur requires browser support and content behind the card. Heavy blur on many elements can cost rendering performance.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
